description: This file implements a class for reading SpreadsheetML (Excel 2003 XML format) files within the PhpSpreadsheet library. It provides methods to identify, parse, and extract data, worksheet info, and styles from XML spreadsheet files, leveraging SimpleXML for XML processing.

classes.name: PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Reader\Xml
classes.description: A class for reading SpreadsheetML (XML format for Excel 2003) spreadsheet files, providing methods for identifying, loading, and parsing XML spreadsheet files into PhpSpreadsheet's Spreadsheet object.

methods.name: canRead
methods.description: Determines whether the specified file can be read as a SpreadsheetML XML file by checking for signature strings in the file content.

methods.name: trySimpleXMLLoadString
methods.description: Tries to load the contents as a SimpleXML object, throws an exception if invalid XML.

methods.name: listWorksheetNames
methods.description: Returns the names of worksheets in the spreadsheet file without fully loading the spreadsheet.

methods.name: listWorksheetInfo
methods.description: Provides info about each worksheet, like name, last column, total rows, etc.

methods.name: loadSpreadsheetFromString
methods.description: Creates a Spreadsheet object from a string containing the XML spreadsheet data.

methods.name: loadSpreadsheetFromFile
methods.description: Creates a Spreadsheet object from a file containing the XML spreadsheet data.

methods.name: loadIntoExisting
methods.description: Loads data into an existing Spreadsheet object from a file or string contents.

methods.name: parseCellComment
methods.description: Parses cell comments from the XML and adds them to the spreadsheet.

methods.name: parseRichText
methods.description: Converts an annotation string into a RichText object.

methods.name: getAttributes
methods.description: Helper method to extract attributes from a SimpleXMLElement.
